assistant|hawaii_attraction_recommendati: Recommended Oahu attractions: Waikiki Beach, Pearl Harbor and USS Arizona Memorial, Hanauma Bay Nature Preserve

assistant|phone_charging_accessory_recom: Recommended packing portable power bank, car charger, and waterproof phone case

assistant|haleakala_sunrise_reservation: Book sunrise viewing reservation on the Haleakala National Park website up to 60 days in advance
assistant|haleakala_sunrise_timing: Park opens at 3:00 AM; arrive at least 30 minutes before sunrise; summit is about 1.5 hour drive from most Maui hotels
assistant|haleakala_summit_weather: Temperature can drop to around 40°F (4°C) before sunrise; dress in layers with warm jacket, gloves, hat
assistant|maui_hiking_trail_recommendati: Waihee Ridge Trail: 2.5-mile out-and-back, moderate incline with some stairs
Iao Valley State Park Trails: includes 0.6-mile Iao Valley Stream Trail, gentle and family-friendly
Makena Landing Beach Trail: 1.5-mile out-and-back, relatively flat and easy
Haleakala National Park Trails: beginner-friendly 1.5-mile Halemau'u Trail
Twin Falls Trail: 2-mile out-and-back to waterfall and swimming hole
assistant|road_to_hana_stop_recommendati: Twin Falls: popular stop with waterfall and swimming hole
Hana Lava Tube: largest lava tube on Maui with petroglyphs
Wai'anapanapa State Park: black sand beach, hiking trails, ancient Hawaiian temples
Hana Town: charming town with shops, restaurants, cafes
Oheo Gulch: series of waterfalls and pools for swimming
Ho'okipa Beach: world-renowned windsurfing spot, chance to see sea turtles
Mile Marker 32: scenic lookout with breathtaking coastline views
Koki Beach: beautiful beach with scenic hike to Koki Point
Hana Farm Road: scenic drive through tropical landscape with waterfalls and local farms
Charles Lindbergh's Grave: historic site, final resting place of the famous aviator
assistant|car_rental_company_recommendat: Recommended companies: Alamo, Enterprise, National, Hertz, Maui Car Rentals
assistant|car_rental_tip: Book in advance, especially during peak season (December to April)
Review credit card and travel insurance policies for car rental insurance coverage
Inspect the car before leaving the rental lot and note any damage
assistant|maui_driving_tip: Gas stations can be limited on the island; fill up when possible

assistant|hawaii_power_sockets: Hawaii uses Type A and Type B power sockets
assistant|laptop_charging_type: Dell XPS 13 uses a USB-C power adapter
assistant|smartphone_charging_type: Samsung Galaxy S22 uses a USB-C charging port
assistant|power_bank_model: Anker PowerCore 20000 efficiency ~70-80%, delivering ~14,000-16,000mAh usable power
Anker PowerCore 20000 should be sufficient for moderate use; backup optional
assistant|power_bank_charge_estimate_mod: Moderate user: ~3-4 full phone charges or 1-2 partial laptop charges
assistant|power_bank_charge_estimate_hea: Heavy user: ~2-3 full phone charges or 1 partial laptop charge
assistant|hawaii_packing_clothing: Pack lightweight breathable clothing, swimwear, walking shoes, sandals, light jacket, rain jacket, dressier outfit
assistant|hawaii_packing_beach: Pack reef-safe sunscreen, sunglasses, beach towel, water bottle, snorkeling gear, water shoes
assistant|hawaii_packing_electronics: Pack laptop, phone, Anker PowerCore 20000, multi-port travel adapter, camera and charger, portable charger for watch
assistant|hawaii_packing_misc: Pack travel documents, medications, insect repellent, umbrella, reusable bag, travel-sized toiletries
assistant|hawaii_weather_temperature: Daytime temps mid-70s to mid-80s F (23-30 C); nighttime mid-60s to low 70s F (18-22 C)
assistant|hawaii_weather_rainfall: Wet season November to March; dry season April to October; showers brief
assistant|hawaii_weather_sunshine: Average 9-10 hours direct sunshine; sunrise ~6:00 am, sunset ~6:30 pm
assistant|hawaii_weather_islands: Oahu and Maui drier/sunnier; Kauai and Big Island get more rainfall; snow on Mauna Kea and Mauna Loa
assistant|hawaii_weather_packing: Pack lightweight clothing, light jacket for evenings, rain gear, comfortable shoes, sun protection
